description: Returns the night-out planner's supported places, route styles and vibes, built from the venues on record and the planner's style and vibe tables, not from a fixed example list. Places are some places with validated venues: not a ranking and not a coverage claim. Styles and vibes are the ones a plan can apply. Read-only and free. Success returns status, meaning, say_to_owner, places, styles and vibes (as structuredContent and as JSON text). For a route, call drinkedin_plan_evening. A plan is for people of legal drinking age where they are.
name: drinkedin_get_guide

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.

places.description: Some places with validated venues, from the venue register. Not a ranking and not a coverage claim.
